methodologyNotes: Twelve traction/recovery boards were verified 2026-08-09 primarily against manufacturer/brand storefronts (MAXTRAX, ARB USA, TRED Outdoors, Smittybilt, Rhino USA Inc, USA ActionTrax, MAXSA Innovations, TrailFX, Bunker Indust, Overland Vehicle Systems via Nomadic Supply) and corroborating authorized-dealer pages (TrailRax, Sherpa Equipment Co, AutoZone, Amazon) fetched directly; specs missing from a brand's own page and not corroborated elsewhere are left null rather than guessed, and the two suggested seed entries that could not be resolved to a real distinct product on the intended platforms ("GEN3 Traction Boards" and "X-BULL Recovery Tracks" both turned out to denote the same X-BULL Gen 3.0 line) were kept as-is for X-BULL and the GEN3 slot was filled with FIERYRED, a genuinely separate brand selling the same generation-3 board design, noted here rather than silently duplicated.

products.name: MAXTRAX MKII Recovery Boards (Pair)
products.priceNote: Current price on maxtrax.com.au's US storefront (all 12 color options priced identically); free shipping over $179

specs.Tread / nub design: Aggressive large cleats with double-edged (reversible) tread face, keyhole accessory mounting points, six built-in carry handles and an integrated shovel/dig-out blade on each end
specs.Mounting pin compatibility: Keyhole-style accessory mounting points; compatible with MAXTRAX-branded mounting hardware

products.provenance: MAXTRAX's own collection page confirms $319.00 pricing and 12 available colors. Dimensions (45 x 13 x 3.5 in.), material, and weight (8 lb per board / 16 lb per pair, 17-18 lb shipped) corroborated identically across authorized dealers TrailRax and Sherpa Equipment Co, both of which reproduce MAXTRAX's own spec copy. Neither MAXTRAX's own page nor either dealer page states a numeric load/weight rating (a commonly repeated third-party figure of '10,000 lb static load' could not be traced to any fetched primary or dealer source), so load capacity is left null rather than assumed. Temperature resistance is not published by MAXTRAX and is left null.

products.priceNote: Current price on ActionTrax's official store (usactiontrax.com), all color options priced identically

Thickness and temperature resistance are not published and left null. Weight capacity is expressed here as the fleet-wide GVW rating (10,000-60,000 lb) rather than a single number since ActionTrax itself states it as a range.
